# Usage Jump around S-TUN-002 due to Stadium Event

- **Classification:** expected_event
- **Root cause:** expected_event at `S-TUN-002`
- **Confidence:** high (Direct temporal and spatial correlation with a massive external stadium event, supported by anomaly alerts and KPI deviations across the affected sites, with maintenance, equipment failures, and configuration changes ruled out by direct checks.)
- **Impact:** 2026-09-11 18:15 to 2026-09-11 21:45
- **Cause time:** 2026-09-11 18:18
- **Affected:** S-TUN-002, S-TUN-001, S-TUN-003

## Summary

A large crowd attendance at a football match at Stade Olympique de Rades (EVT-001) caused a temporary surge in traffic and active users across multiple sites including S-TUN-002.

Traffic, active users, and PRB utilization spiked above baseline across S-TUN-001, S-TUN-002, and S-TUN-003 starting around 18:15 on 2026-09-11 and fully recovering by 21:45.

## Timeline

- 2026-09-11 18:15: Earliest KPI onset detected with S-TUN-003 dl_volume_mb rising above baseline. [T5]
- 2026-09-11 18:18: Football match at Stade Olympique de Rades (EVT-001) started. [T3, EVT-001]
- 2026-09-11 18:30: Detector alert ALR-0018 began, showing traffic, active users, and PRB utilization spikes on S-TUN-001, S-TUN-002, and S-TUN-003. [T1, ALR-0018]
- 2026-09-11 21:43: External stadium event EVT-001 ended. [T3, EVT-001]
- 2026-09-11 21:45: KPIs and active users fully recovered across all affected sites. [T5]

## Evidence

- Traffic, active users, and PRB utilization spiked significantly on S-TUN-002 between 18:30 and 21:30 on 2026-09-11. [T1, ALR-0018]
- A football match at Stade Olympique de Rades (EVT-001) occurred from 18:18 to 21:43 on 2026-09-11 with an expected attendance of 40,000. [T3, EVT-001]
- No maintenance windows were scheduled on S-TUN-002, its parent link LNK-TUN-01-B, AGG-TUN-01, or ancestors during the event window. [T4]
- No configuration changes were made on S-TUN-002, S-TUN-001, S-TUN-003, or their parents between 18:00 and 00:00. [T6]

## Inferences

- The traffic surge was driven by high crowd density from the nearby stadium event causing increased user activity. [T1, T3, T5, EVT-001]

## Hypotheses

1. **expected_event** at S-TUN-002: confirmed. The timing and duration of the traffic surge match the football match at the nearby stadium perfectly, and all technical failures or changes have been ruled out. [T1, T3, T5, EVT-001]
2. **bad_change** at S-TUN-002: rejected. No configuration changes were executed on S-TUN-002 or its related parent nodes during the timeframe. [T6]
3. **transport_failure** at LNK-TUN-01-B: rejected. No maintenance or transport failures were found on the link or aggregation router during the incident window. [T2, T4]

## Ruled out

- T4: Rule out maintenance: No maintenance windows were scheduled on the sites, microwave link, or aggregation routers during the incident window.
- T6: Rule out changes: No configuration changes were recorded on the affected sites or their parent transport path during the incident window.

## Recommended actions

- Monitor high-capacity events routinely to ensure localized PRB utilization does not exhaust site resources.
